query:
-- Update Clue Dallas article with correct date and production photos

UPDATE news 
SET 
  date = '2022-09-08',
  publishedAt = '2022-09-08',
  coverImageUrl = 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/iNqnfBSUpYHlBUoc.jpg',
  blocks = JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for Dallas Theatre Center''s production of Clue On Stage, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for Jo Winiarski''s intricate scenic design. This comedic mystery brought the beloved board game to life with a versatile set featuring multiple rooms of the iconic mansion.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'header', 'content', 'The Design Challenge'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'Clue On Stage required a flexible scenic design that could transform seamlessly between the various rooms of the Boddy Mansion—from the grand foyer to the kitchen, library, study, and conservatory. Jo Winiarski''s design utilized rotating panels, sliding walls, and modular set pieces to create quick transitions between locations while maintaining the period aesthetic of a 1950s mansion.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'image', 'url', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/bmCwRTHvXxigcNsC.jpg', 'caption', 'The Boddy Mansion''s elegant interior featuring rich wood paneling, ornate wallpaper, and period furnishings. Photo: Dallas Theatre Center'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'header', 'content', 'Technical Execution'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'Brandon''s role focused on creating detailed construction drawings and 3D models to help realize the complex scenic elements. The design required precise engineering for the moving set pieces, ensuring smooth transitions during the fast-paced comedy while maintaining structural integrity and safety standards.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'image', 'url', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/QzNQzYiErEeDmGsY.jpg', 'caption', 'The colorful finale scene showcasing the versatile set design with dramatic lighting. Photo: Dallas Theatre Center'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'header', 'content', 'Production Success'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'text', 'content', 'The production ran at Dallas Theatre Center from August 10 to September 8, 2022, delighting audiences with its clever staging and comedic timing. The scenic design successfully balanced the need for multiple distinct locations with the practical demands of a fast-paced mystery comedy.'),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'team', 'title', 'The Creative Team', 'members', JSON_ARRAY(
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Playwright', 'name', 'Sandy Rustin'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Director', 'name', 'Joel Ferrell'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Scenic Designer', 'name', 'Jo Winiarski'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Assistant Scenic Designer', 'name', 'Brandon PT Davis'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Costume Designer', 'name', 'Lyle Huchton'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Lighting Designer', 'name', 'Aaron Johansen'),
      JSON_OBJECT('role', 'Sound Designer', 'name', 'John Flores')
    )),
    JSON_OBJECT('type', 'link', 'url', 'https://www.dallastheatercenter.org/', 'text', 'Visit Dallas Theatre Center')
  )
WHERE slug = 'clue-on-stage-dallas-theatre-center';
